map.输入主轴转速、下压力与焊接速度，估算摩擦热输入功率及单位线能量（基于轴肩摩擦模型: Enter spindle speed, downforce and welding speed to estimate the friction heat-input power and specific line energy (based on a shoulder-friction model).
map.基于搅拌摩擦焊(FSW)功率模型：轴肩环形接触面摩擦功率 Q 由转速 N、摩擦系: Based on a friction stir welding (FSW) power model: the shoulder annular contact friction power Q is integrated from speed N, friction coefficient mu, downforce F and shoulder radius R; the specific line energy E = Q / v determines heat input and weld quality, for process parameter check.
map.💡 公式：摩擦功率 Q = (2π·N/60)·(2/3)·μ·F·R（轴肩环形: Tip: formula: friction power Q = (2 pi N / 60) times (2/3) times mu times F times R (shoulder annular contact integral), specific line energy E = Q / v. N is speed, F is downforce, R is shoulder radius.
map.摩擦系数 μ 典型范围 0.3～0.6（钢/铝界面），可按材料调整: Friction coefficient mu typically 0.3 to 0.6 (steel / aluminum interface), adjustable by material
map.本模型为热输入估算，未考虑搅拌针产热与材料热物性，结果仅供工艺参考: This model is a heat-input estimate; it ignores pin heat and material thermo-physics, for process reference only
map.📚 深度解析：搅拌摩擦焊参数计算（热输入与线能量）: In-depth: Friction Stir Welding Parameters (heat input and line energy)
map.焊接工艺开发：由转速、下压力与焊速估算热输入功率: Welding process development: estimate heat-input power from speed, downforce and weld speed
map.参数优化：调整转速/焊速使线能量落在合适区间: Parameter optimization: adjust speed / weld speed so line energy falls in a suitable range
map.缺陷预防：通过峰值温度与进给比判断是否过热或未焊合: Defect prevention: judge overheating or lack of bonding by peak temperature and feed ratio
map.算法：轴肩半径 R = 轴肩直径/2/1000（m）；: Algorithm: shoulder radius R = shoulder diameter / 2 / 1000 (m);
map.ω = 2π×转速/60（rad/s）；摩擦热输入功率 Q = (2/3)×μ×: omega = 2 pi times speed / 60 (rad/s); friction heat-input power Q = (2/3) times mu times downforce times omega times R (W, downforce converted from kN to N); specific line energy E = Q / welding speed (J/mm); shoulder outer-edge linear speed = omega times R times 1000 (mm/s); feed ratio = speed / welding speed; peak temperature estimated as min(580, 20 + 0.35 times Q / weld speed) (aluminum alloy baseline). E below 300 is low heat input, 300 to 800 medium, above 800 high.
map.例：800rpm、下压力 15kN、焊速 3mm/s、轴肩 18mm、μ=0.4: Example: 800 rpm, downforce 15 kN, weld speed 3 mm/s, shoulder 18 mm, mu 0.4 gives R = 0.009 m, omega = 83.78 rad/s, heat-input power 3015.9 W, specific line energy 1005.3 J/mm (high heat input), outer-edge speed 753.98 mm/s, feed ratio 266.67, estimated peak temperature 371.9 °C. If changed to 1200 rpm, 10 kN, weld speed 5 mm/s, shoulder 15 mm, mu 0.35 gives Q = 2199.1 W, E = 439.8 J/mm (medium heat input), outer-edge speed 942.48 mm/s, peak temperature 173.9 °C.
map.工具按 转速(rpm)/焊速(mm/s) 直接相除，单位上还需再除以 60 才是: The tool divides speed (rpm) by weld speed (mm/s) directly; the unit still needs to be divided by 60 to be rev/mm (here actually 4.44 rev/mm). The feed ratio reflects the number of stirring passes per unit weld length; it is a key parameter for judging whether heat input is sufficient and whether tunnel-type defects will occur.
map.系数 2/3 从哪来？: Where does the 2/3 coefficient come from?
map.来自轴肩环形接触面的摩擦功率积分：对半径 r 处微元所受压力做功 μ·ω·r 积: It comes from integrating the friction power over the shoulder annular contact: integrating the work mu times omega times r done by the pressure on a micro-element at radius r gives (2/3) mu F omega R, closer to the actual heat-input distribution than directly multiplying by the outer-edge linear speed.
